title: Early-exit Mirror readout views
hypothesis: Three exit readouts can be represented by one shared head plus Mirror depth coordinates at lower actual bytes than separate heads while preserving exit quality and fixed-policy MAC count.
physical_object: three classifier readout matrices at hidden dimension 64 and 8 classes
mirror_coordinate: one scalar depth coordinate per exit over a shared readout basis
logical_multiplicity: three depth-specific prediction heads used at exits 2,4,6
controls: shared basis with Mirror depth coordinates

development.selection_metric: per-exit and mixed-policy NLL/accuracy, serialized head bytes, average MACs

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY inference payload after reload

success_gate: Both dev seeds: mixed NLL within 0.01 separate heads, per-exit NLL within 0.02, >=10% head-byte savings, identical average MAC count; direct coefficients >=10% larger for Mirror-specific value.
failure_gate: Quality gate missed or direct control within 10%; fresh sealed.
boundaries: no trained Transformer or adaptive routing evidence
